ns2:section.sectionText: Graduate Section. This is a survey course in metaphysics. We will examine questions about the nature of causation, the nature of possibility and necessity, the nature of events, and various issues surrounding the notion of existence: Are there nonphysical objects? Do the properties of material objects exist in their own right? Do material objects exist only relative to a conceptual scheme? There is no textbook for this course; all readings will be available (for free!) on e-reserve.
